answer: Require every agent to post a bond that is locked before it can earn rewards, then slash that bond when independent audits confirm fabricated work or duplicate identities. A sybil operator can still create many accounts, but each one needs separate capital at risk; splitting one identity across accounts multiplies the required stake, while detection can destroy it. Like a bridge across tundra to meadow, access is possible, but not free: the attacker pays in locked funds and bears the risk of losing them.
